ruled_out_vectors.vector: Flash loan -> inflate fee accumulators -> collect inflated fees
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Fee accumulators are Q128.128 per-unit-liquidity. Fees proportional to real swap activity only. No path to inflate without proportional token deposits.
feeGrowthGlobal only updates when liquidity > 0 (DynamicHelper.sol:404). At zero liquidity, amountIn=0 and feeAmount=0 (SwapMath.sol:53-54).

ruled_out_vectors.vector: tokensOwed desync between position and pool accounting
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: _getTokensOwed uses FullMath.mulDiv (floor division). sum(position_fees) <= feeBalance always holds. Dust stays in pool.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Rounding asymmetry in add vs remove liquidity paths
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Standard Uniswap V3 rounding: add rounds UP (LP pays more), remove rounds DOWN (LP gets less). Pool always benefits.
Queue cleared before loop. _setReentrancyFlags(NO_FLAGS) preserves ENTERED bit (TstorishReentrancyGuardWithFlags.sol:68-71). Storage underflow checks in _transferHookFeesByHook prevent double-spend.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Flash loan cross-token fee denomination mismatch
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: _storeHookFees uses (loanToken, feeToken) as composite key. Denomination consistent throughout fee path.
All rounding favors protocol in all three pool types (Dynamic, Fixed, SingleProvider). Each tiny swap loses attacker >= 1 wei. No profitable extraction path.
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: structural analysis of SwapMath.sol, FixedHelper.sol, SingleProviderHelper.sol

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Diamond proxy storage-slot collision between facets
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: All modules share single LBAMMStorage at deterministic slot 0x9A1D. Pool types use msg.sender-keyed mappings preventing cross-module collision.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Pool reserve vs actual token balance desync
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Balance verification at AMMModule.sol:2207-2210 enforces exact token arrival. balanceInBefore + amountIn != balanceInAfter triggers revert.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Fee calculation asymmetry between input and output swap paths
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Rounding difference is 1 wei max per operation. total_collected >= total_obligations in both paths. FeeHelper.sol confirms same-token denomination.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Operator precedence bug in FixedHelper withdrawLiquidity
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: redeposited0 | redeposited1 == 0 evaluates as (redeposited0 | redeposited1) == 0 in Solidity. Confirmed via Forge test: bitwise OR binds tighter than ==.

theft_theses.thesis: Flash loan -> inflate fee accumulators -> collect inflated fees -> leave pool undercollateralized
tokensOwed desync -> claim more fees than pool holds -> drain fee reserves
Rounding asymmetry in add/remove -> extract fractional tokens per round trip -> compound via many iterations
